overrides.0x82088D08:
[Rest]
Let a pitcher focus on recovering from fatigue.

Move the cursor to the left of the preparation setting
and press<×> to toggle Rest.
With Rest selected, the pitcher stops preparing for
appearances and recovers much more quickly.

While resting, a pitcher who enters a game cannot be
expected to pitch well.
The fatigue recovered will also be greatly reduced.

Avoid using pitchers assigned to Rest whenever possible.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 4/5
overrides.0x82088FD8:
[Relief]
Prepare a pitcher to appear in relief.

Select Relief so the pitcher is ready whenever needed.

On game days, bullpen preparation means little fatigue
is recovered.
On off days, the pitcher instead follows the equivalent
of a Rest instruction and focuses on recovery.

If repeated outings leave a pitcher tired, assign Rest
to let them recover.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 3/5
overrides.0x82089250:
[Starter]
Prepare a pitcher for a starting appearance.

Select Starter to begin preparing for the next start.
Starter Stamina builds each day.
More stamina allows a longer outing.

Changing preparation away from Starter causes
accumulated Starter Stamina to be lost.
Choose changes carefully.
Making an appearance also uses up accumulated Starter
Stamina.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 2/5
overrides.0x820894F0:
Learn how to give pitcher preparation instructions!

Preparation instructions are available for pitchers on
your top team.

The preparation options are Starter Prep and Relief Prep
. Pitchers prepare according to your instructions.
You can also assign Rest to tired pitchers.

Matching preparation to each pitcher's role is a key to
winning!<+LR>Switch <○>Close 1/5
overrides.0x82093D50:
[What Is Waiver Order?]
The order is based on last season's standings.

It starts with the sixth-place team in the league
that lost the Japan Series.
The Central and Pacific Leagues
alternate, with the Japan Series champion picking last.<+LR>Switch <○>Close 2/2
